REGULATION_NAME: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
APPLICABILITY_SCOPE: Any establishment discharging trade effluent or sewage, or drawing/using water in a manner covered by Section 25
APPLICABILITY_TRIGGER: Same as above — any site that discharges effluent/sewage or draws water under Section 25
GOVERNING_INSTRUMENT_PERMIT: Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO)
